categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC metadata and schema generation in src/rpc/util.h, src/rpc/server.cpp, and src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds machine-readable discriminator metadata to OpenRPC schemas to eliminate hardcoded mappings in typed client libraries. The PR description notes that client libraries like corepc and btcd currently have to hardcode the mapping between verbosity levels and getblock result branches.
